Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
Hello,

this is a "Vidal Jarbeaux" question, so maybe it has been answered before ...

> Vidal Jarbeaux
>
> Camarilla: Vidal can meet the clan, sect, or non-infernal vampire trait (e.g., anarch) requirement to play any card. He can meet a given requirement only once each game. +1 bleed.
>
Since I could find nothing on "traits" in the Rulings Sections, I will take the following definition for them.

> Card wrote:
> Traits are basically the bold terms found at the top of card text to give it some kind of label. Some traits have rulebook-defined meaning or effect. Others do not. Clan and uniqueness are also traits.
>
Now my question: If "X" is a trait, is "non-X" also a trait?

For example: Can Vidal benefit twice from "Lilith's Blessing"? First time being non-Bahari, second time emulating non-Bahari (being actually Bahari)?

> Lilith's Blessing
>
> Master.
> Put this card in play. As a master phase action, you may tap this card to search your library for a master: Discipline card and choose a ready non-Bahari vampire you control who has no blood. That vampire gains the Discipline card (if any) and 3 blood and becomes Bahari.
>
Thanks in advance!

National Coordinator Germany  nc [dot] germany [at] magenta [dot] de

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Hakuron wrote:
> Hello,
>
> this is a "Vidal Jarbeaux" question, so maybe it has been answered before ...
>
> > Vidal Jarbeaux
> >
> > Camarilla: Vidal can meet the clan, sect, or non-infernal vampire trait (e.g., anarch) requirement to play any card. He can meet a given requirement only once each game. +1 bleed.
> >
> Since I could find nothing on "traits" in the Rulings Sections, I will take the following definition for them.
>
> > Card wrote:
> > Traits are basically the bold terms found at the top of card text to give it some kind of label. Some traits have rulebook-defined meaning or effect. Others do not. Clan and uniqueness are also traits.
> >
> Now my question: If "X" is a trait, is "non-X" also a trait?
>
As far as Vidal is concerned, yes.  [LSJ 20081120]

> Hakuron wrote:
> For example: Can Vidal benefit twice from "Lilith's Blessing"? First time being non-Bahari, second time emulating non-Bahari (being actually Bahari)?
>
> > Lilith's Blessing
> >
> > Master.
> > Put this card in play. As a master phase action, you may tap this card to search your library for a master: Discipline card and choose a ready non-Bahari vampire you control who has no blood. That vampire gains the Discipline card (if any) and 3 blood and becomes Bahari.
> >
Lilith's Blessing has no requirement when played, so Vidal's text doesn't interact with Lilith's Blessing - Vidal can only fake a trait to have a card played, and not when it would be used.

So, short answer: Vidal can get 3 blood from Lilith's Blessing only once per Vidal.
